author: c. t. miles
title: Mount Vernon Planning Board meeting cancelled for April 8, next session set for May 6
text:
The City of Mount Vernon announced on April 8 that the Planning Board meeting scheduled for Wednesday, April 8, has been cancelled. The city said the next regularly scheduled Planning Board meeting will take place on May 6.
The cancellation affects residents and stakeholders who participate in city planning matters. The Planning Board plays a role in shaping local development and community projects.
Mount Vernon provides municipal services through departments focused on planning, community development, and recreation, according to the official website according to the official website . The city also supports programs for seniors and veterans as part of its commitment to community welfare according to the official website .
As a municipal government, Mount Vernon features an elected mayor serving as chief executive along with a five-member city council according to the official website . Services offered include urban renewal initiatives and veteran assistance programs according to the official website .
The Department of Recreation in Mount Vernon achieved its official status in 1931 according to the official website . Residents are encouraged by officials to stay connected for further updates regarding public meetings.
